status: proposed software peers only; no controller/provider RTL qualification
terminal_policy: already offered packets immutable; native error precedes CANCELLED; no successful G_END on cancel

coordination_messages.name: RX_CLOSE_REQ
coordination_messages.requires: no DATA link or held DATA; all potential sources stopped

coordination_messages.name: RX_CLOSE_ACK
coordination_messages.requires: registered peer has physically/logically closed all relevant sources in the model

coordination_messages.name: RESET_ACK
coordination_messages.requires: participant actually reset; duplicate, unknown, stale and unapplied ACK rejected

admission_after_reset: provider future response queues, adapters and transport empty
one additional modeled quiet tick; not hardware reset/CDC timing
new epoch greater than poison epoch

native_wire.observer_origin: proof only; never used for routing/filtering
native_wire.guarantee: conditional on provider quiescence/reset contract; identical old response during new context is intrinsically ambiguous
